component.name: hwcloud-smn
component.title: Huawei Simple Message Notification (SMN)
component.description: Publish messages to topics of Huawei Cloud Simple Message Notification (SMN).
component.label: cloud,messaging

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

producerIn.description: The message to publish, as text: bytes, a stream or a file are read as text, an XML Source or a DOM node as its XML text, and a Map, a List or a POJO is published as JSON. No body fails for publishAsTextMessage, while publishAsTemplatedMessage can have no body, with the template from the CamelHwCloudSmnTemplateName exchange property. The topic comes from the CamelHwCloudSmnTopic exchange property

producerOut.description: Unchanged, with the ids of the message and of the request in the CamelHwCloudSmnMessageId and CamelHwCloudSmnRequestId exchange properties. The message id is also in the deprecated CamelHwCloudSmnMesssageId exchange property

smnService.label: producer
smnService.description: The SMN service that the producer calls. Only publishMessageService is supported.

accessKey.description: The access key ID (AK) of the Huawei Cloud credentials. If not set, the accessKey of the serviceKeys option is used.

endpoint.description: The endpoint URL of SMN, for example https://smn.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com. When set, the client uses it instead of the endpoint of the region option. The region option is still needed for the URN of the topic.

messageTtl.description: The time to live of the published message in seconds, after which SMN no longer delivers it. SMN accepts at most 86400 (one day). The CamelHwCloudSmnMessageTtl exchange property replaces this option.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs: publishAsTextMessage or publishAsTemplatedMessage. The CamelHwCloudSmnOperation exchange property replaces this option.

projectId.description: The ID of the Huawei Cloud project of the topic. The producer uses it in the URN of the topic and in the credentials of the requests.

proxyHost.description: The host name or IP address of the proxy server. The producer uses a proxy only when this option is set.

proxyPassword.description: The password to authenticate with the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyUser options are set.

proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyHost option is set.

proxyUser.description: The user name to authenticate with the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyHost option is set.

region.description: The region ID of SMN, for example cn-north-4. The producer uses it in the URN of the topic, and to find the endpoint of SMN when the endpoint option is not set.

secretKey.description: The secret access key (SK) of the Huawei Cloud credentials. If not set, the secretKey of the serviceKeys option is used.

serviceKeys.description: The AK/SK pair as an org.apache.camel.component.huaweicloud.common.models.ServiceKeys. Its accessKey and its secretKey are each used when the option of the same name is not set.

ignoreSslVerification.label: security
ignoreSslVerification.description: Whether to skip the verification of the TLS certificate of the server. This makes the connection insecure: use it only for testing.
